excavation-site.name: Excavation Site: Wetlands
excavation-site.entrance: In the cliffside cliffs overlooking Whelgar's Excavation Site in central Wetlands.

bosses.name: Saltspine
bosses.mechanics: Roams the starting marsh among elite crocolisks. Clear trash thoroughly before engaging him. He hits hard with high base health.

abilities.name: Large Health Pool
abilities.desc: Hits hard with high sustained melee swings. Tank keep defensive buffs active.

bosses.name: Shadetooth
bosses.mechanics: Slay the raptor matriarch in the tall brush. A wave of raptor adds spawns upon her death; wipe out the wave quickly before Shadetooth charges in.

abilities.name: Raptors in the Grass
abilities.desc: Small ambush raptors jump from foliage applying stacking bleed effects.

abilities.name: Wave of the Pack
abilities.desc: Kill every raptor in the incoming pack before Shadetooth arrives to prevent overlap.

abilities.name: Primal Fear
abilities.desc: Fears the tank repeatedly. Shamans should drop Tremor Totem; Priests use Fear Ward.

bosses.name: Highland Horror
bosses.mechanics: Guards the Dragonmaw orc encampment. Pull the surrounding Dragonmaw orcs in small packs first, then engage the horror.

abilities.name: Dragonmaw Vanguard
abilities.desc: Pulls easily with nearby camp. Pull isolated packs to avoid overwhelming the tank.

drops.name: Horrible Rootcore
drops.stats: Starts Horrors in the Highland quest for Rethiel the Greenwarden.

bosses.name: Relic Guardian
bosses.mechanics: Dormant at the end of the spider cavern. Click the ancient Titan console next to him to initiate the encounter.

abilities.name: Threat Protocol Reset
abilities.desc: Drops all threat and snaps to highest DPS. Damage dealers throttle bursts; tank must taunt immediately.

drops.name: Titan Relic
drops.stats: Starts Prehistoric Prism / Earthen Echo questlines.

quests.name: Prehistoric Prism / Earthen Echo
quests.rewards: Explorer's League Dustcover (Back) / Healer's Staff / Heavehammer (2H Mace) / Furs of the Earthen Ring

quests.name: Horrors in the Highland
quests.rewards: Ironwood Destroyer (2H Mace) / Curl of Life (Ring) / Hornbeam Heft (1H Axe)

quests.name: Changing Tastes
quests.rewards: Serrated Raptor Claw (1H Dagger) / Recipe: Twice-Spiced Raptor Slice

quests.name: Dorin's Kin / Songblade Stabilizer
quests.rewards: Daewyn's Girdle (Cloth Waist) / Songblade Stabilizer (Mail Waist)

city-of-dalaran.name: City of Dalaran
city-of-dalaran.entrance: Sewer pipe entrance beneath Dalaran purple dome in Alterac Mountains. Key required (Dalaran Sewer Key).

bosses.name: Atrexis the Grave Knight
bosses.mechanics: Stands inside the ritual summoning circle in the sewer underbelly, flanked by Kirin Tor Necromancers.

abilities.name: Unholy Frenzy
abilities.desc: +75% Attack Speed for 20 sec. Shaman Purge or Priest Dispel Magic immediately!

abilities.name: Thrash
abilities.desc: Swings twice simultaneously; heavy incoming spike damage.

abilities.name: Raise Dead
abilities.desc: Skeletons rise continually around the circle. Cleave them down quickly.

abilities.name: Disarm
abilities.desc: Takes tank weapon away for 6 seconds; keep defensive mitigation rolling.

bosses.name: Lyn the Ignored
bosses.mechanics: Secret summoning encounter: player with Tome of Dalaran clicks pink circle in northeast market stalls room.

abilities.name: Shadow Bolt Volley
abilities.desc: Hits all party members within 30 yards. Healers prepare group heals.

abilities.name: Curse of Thorns
abilities.desc: Damages attackers on hit. Decurse targets immediately.

bosses.name: Arcane Anomaly
bosses.mechanics: Channels lethal directional beam and arcane bolts.

abilities.name: Focal Blast
abilities.desc: 3s cast, channels a continuous beam hitting 4x per second. Step out of the path immediately!

abilities.name: Arcane Bolt
abilities.desc: Regular 1.5s cast dealing heavy arcane spike damage to the tank.

bosses.name: Arcanic Enigma
bosses.mechanics: Polymorphs party members and silences spellcasters.

abilities.name: Manamorph
abilities.desc: Polymorphs target into an animal for 8 sec. Dispel immediately.

abilities.name: Silence Wave
abilities.desc: 10-second silence aura. Healers must position beyond 20 yards.

abilities.name: Arcane Manalings
abilities.desc: Summons manalings that must be burned down with AoE.

bosses.name: Unstable Sentinel
bosses.mechanics: Ancient construct with lethal 25-yard pulsing AoE. Drops the Spinning Wheel blueprint!

abilities.name: Malfunction
abilities.desc: Channels 6s, pulsing 140 damage every 2s within 25 yards. Ranged stay back; melee back off during cast!

bosses.name: Shade of the Archmage
bosses.mechanics: Final boss of Dalaran inside the Violet Chamber. Mass polymorphs when out of mana and channels Evocation.

abilities.name: Bounding Mana
abilities.desc: Mana orb flies between players and boss. Passing through it deals heavy arcane damage and silences for 6s!

abilities.name: Mass Polymorph & Evocation
abilities.desc: When mana reaches 0, transforms entire group into sheep for 8s while channeling Evocation.

abilities.name: Stay in the Room
abilities.desc: Leaving the chamber resets the encounter to 100% health.

quests.name: Heart of Disruption
quests.source: Image of Archmage Modera (Lordamere Lake) / Magus Wordeen (Tarren Mill)
quests.rewards: Spellguard Pauldrons (Mail) / Renewing Footpads (Leather) / Defender of Dalaran (2H Mace) OR Battle Spaulders / Enchanted Sandals / Striking Staff

quests.name: Source of Power
quests.rewards: Unstable Power Core (Wand) / Construct Cloak (Cloth Back)
